title: Friday Night Magic 2013: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.
Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.
"How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."
Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.
"It misses nothing and it has no sense of humor." —Barvisa, courtroom scribe
Devil-blades and dripping blood make music Rakdos never tires of hearing.
"The Simic come from the cold slow depths. How could they understand the fire in a wild heart?" —Kroshkar, Gruul shaman
To the Golgari, anything buried is treasure.
"That must weigh heavily on your soul. Let me purge it for you."
